entries.headline: Daulton Varsho came close
entries.story: Daulton Varsho went 2-for-5 with 1 RBI against Zack Littell and the Washington Nationals. Closest call was a double in the 4th: "Daulton Varsho doubles (19) on a line drive to right fielder James Wood. Alejandro Kirk to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.
